== Summary ==
Slip “•Hoth: Snow Trench” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (66, 51, 753, 599)). Version [[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker) (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
